verses.en: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.pt: Vede que grande amor nos tem concedido o Pai: que fôssemos chamados filhos de Deus; e nós o somos. Por isso o mundo não nos conhece; porque não conheceu a ele.
verses.en_web: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
verses.en_bbe: See what great love the Father has given us in naming us the children of God; and such we are. For this reason the world does not see who we are, because it did not see who he was.

verses.en: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
verses.pt: Amados, agora somos filhos de Deus, e ainda não é manifesto o que havemos de ser. Mas sabemos que, quando ele se manifestar, seremos semelhantes a ele; porque assim como é, o veremos.
verses.en_web: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. But we know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.
verses.en_bbe: My loved ones, now we are children of God, and at present it is not clear what we are to be. We are certain that at his revelation we will be like him; for we will see him as he is.

verses.en: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.pt: E todo o que nele tem esta esperança, purifica-se a si mesmo, assim como ele é puro.
verses.en_web: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
verses.en_bbe: And everyone who has this hope in him makes himself holy, even as he is holy.

verses.en: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
verses.pt: Todo aquele que vive habitualmente no pecado também vive na rebeldia, pois o pecado é rebeldia.
verses.en_web: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
verses.en_bbe: Everyone who is a sinner goes against the law, for sin is going against the law.

verses.en: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
verses.pt: E bem sabeis que ele se manifestou para tirar os pecados; e nele não há pecado.
verses.en_web: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and in him is no sin.
verses.en_bbe: And you have knowledge that he came to take away sin: and in him there is no sin.

verses.en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
verses.pt: Todo o que permanece nele não vive pecando; todo o que vive pecando não o viu nem o conhece.
verses.en_web: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
verses.en_bbe: Anyone who is in him does no sin; anyone who is a sinner has not seen him and has no knowledge of him.

verses.en: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.pt: Filhinhos, ninguém vos engane; quem pratica a justiça é justo, assim como ele é justo;
verses.en_web: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.en_bbe: My little children, let no man take you out of the true way: he who does righteousness is upright, even as he is upright;

verses.en: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.pt: quem comete pecado é do Diabo; porque o Diabo peca desde o princípio. Para isto o Filho de Deus se manifestou: para destruir as obras do Diabo.
verses.en_web: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.en_bbe: The sinner is a child of the Evil One; for the Evil One has been a sinner from the first. And the Son of God was seen on earth so that he might put an end to the works of the Evil One.

verses.en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
verses.pt: Aquele que é nascido de Deus não peca habitualmente; porque a semente de Deus permanece nele, e não pode continuar no pecado, porque é nascido de Deus.
verses.en_web: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him; and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
verses.en_bbe: Anyone who is a child of God does no sin, because he still has God's seed in him; he is not able to be a sinner, because God is his Father.

verses.en: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.pt: Nisto são manifestos os filhos de Deus, e os filhos do Diabo: quem não pratica a justiça não é de Deus, nem o que não ama a seu irmão.
verses.en_web: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
verses.en_bbe: In this way it is clear who are the children of God and who are the children of the Evil One; anyone who does not do righteousness or who has no love for his brother, is not a child of God.

verses.en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
verses.pt: Porque esta é a mensagem que ouvistes desde o princípio, que nos amemos uns aos outros,
verses.en_web: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another;
verses.en_bbe: Because this is the word which was given to you from the first, that we are to have love for one another;

verses.en: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
verses.pt: não sendo como Caim, que era do Maligno, e matou a seu irmão. E por que o matou? Porque as suas obras eram más e as de seu irmão justas.
verses.en_web: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one, and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
verses.en_bbe: Not being of the Evil One like Cain, who put his brother to death. And why did he put him to death? Because his works were evil and his brother's works were good.

verses.en: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
verses.pt: Meus irmãos, não vos admireis se o mundo vos odeia.
verses.en_web: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be surprised, my brothers, if the world has no love for you.

verses.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
verses.pt: Nós sabemos que já passamos da morte para a vida, porque amamos os irmãos. Quem não ama permanece na morte.
verses.en_web: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
verses.en_bbe: We are conscious that we have come out of death into life because of our love for the brothers. He who has no love is still in death.

verses.en: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
verses.pt: Todo o que odeia a seu irmão é homicida; e vós sabeis que nenhum homicida tem a vida eterna permanecendo nele.
verses.en_web: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
verses.en_bbe: Anyone who has hate for his brother is a taker of life, and you may be certain that no taker of life has eternal life in him.

verses.en: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.pt: Nisto conhecemos o amor: que Cristo deu a sua vida por nós; e nós devemos dar a vida pelos irmãos.
verses.en_web: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
verses.en_bbe: In this we see what love is, because he gave his life for us; and it is right for us to give our lives for the brothers.

verses.en: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
verses.pt: Quem, pois, tiver bens do mundo, e, vendo o seu irmão necessitando, lhe fechar o seu coração, como permanece nele o amor de Deus?
verses.en_web: But whoever has the world’s goods, and sees his brother in need, and closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
verses.en_bbe: But if a man has this world's goods, and sees that his brother is in need, and keeps his heart shut against his brother, how is it possible for the love of God to be in him?

verses.en: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
verses.pt: Filhinhos, não amemos de palavra, nem de língua, mas por obras e em verdade.
verses.en_web: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
verses.en_bbe: My little children, do not let our love be in word and in tongue, but let it be in act and in good faith.

verses.en: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
verses.pt: Nisto conheceremos que somos da verdade, e diante dele tranqüilizaremos o nosso coração;
verses.en_web: And by this we know that we are of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,
verses.en_bbe: In this way we may be certain that we are true, and may give our heart comfort before him,

verses.en: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verses.pt: porque se o coração nos condena, maior é Deus do que o nosso coração, e conhece todas as coisas.
verses.en_web: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
verses.en_bbe: When our heart says that we have done wrong; because God is greater than our heart, and has knowledge of all things.

verses.en: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
verses.pt: Amados, se o coração não nos condena, temos confiança para com Deus;
verses.en_web: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
verses.en_bbe: My loved ones, if our heart does not say that we have done wrong, we have no fear before him;

verses.en: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.pt: e qualquer coisa que lhe pedirmos, dele a receberemos, porque guardamos os seus mandamentos, e fazemos o que é agradável à sua vista.
verses.en_web: and whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.en_bbe: And he gives us all our requests, because we keep his laws and do the things which are pleasing in his eyes.

verses.en: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
verses.pt: Ora, o seu mandamento é este, que creiamos no nome de seu Filho Jesus Cristo, e nos amemos uns aos outros, como ele nos ordenou.
verses.en_web: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
verses.en_bbe: And this is his law, that we have faith in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love for one another, even as he said to us.

verses.en: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
verses.pt: Quem guarda os seus mandamentos, em Deus permanece e Deus nele. E nisto conhecemos que ele permanece em nós: pelo Espírito que nos tem dado.
verses.en_web: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps his laws is in God and God is in him. And the Spirit which he gave us is our witness that he is in us.
